paragraphs: Evolution Petroleum Corporation ("Evolution," and together with its consolidated subsidiaries, the "Company", "our", "we, "us" or similar terms) is an independent energy company focused on maximizing total returns to its shareholders through the ownership of and investment in onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States. Our long-term goal is to maximize total shareholder return from a diversified portfolio of long-life oil and natural gas properties built through acquisition and through selective development opportunities, production enhancement, and other exploitation efforts on our oil and natural gas properties.
On September 11, 2025, Evolution's Board of Directors approved and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.12 per common share payable September 30, 2025.

On August 4, 2025, we completed the acquisition of certain mineral and royalty interests in the SCOOP/STACK area of Oklahoma from a non-affiliated private seller (the "Minerals Acquisition") in a cash transaction valued at approximately $17.0 million, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. The Minerals Acquisition has an effective date of May 1, 2025. We funded the purchase price for the Minerals Acquisition with a combination of $15.0 million in borrowings under our Senior Secured Credit Facility and cash on hand. The acquired assets include an average royalty interest of 0.6% located on approximately 5,500 net royalty acres located primarily in Grady and Canadian Counties, Oklahoma.

On June 30, 2025, we entered into a syndicated amended and restated senior secured reserve-based credit agreement (the "Senior Secured Credit Facility") with MidFirst Bank, as administrative agent for the lenders party thereto, in an amount up to $200.0 million with an initial borrowing base of $65.0 million maturing on June 30, 2028.

For further discussion of our Senior Secured Credit Facility, see "Liquidity and Capital Resources" within Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Conditions and Results of Operations.

On April 14, 2025, we closed the acquisition of non-operating working interests in certain long-life oil and natural gas wells located primarily in Lea, Eddy and Chaves Counties, New Mexico and Stephens County, Texas (the "TexMex Acquisition") from a private seller. The total purchase price for the TexMex Acquisition was approximately $9.0 million before customary post-closing adjustments, with an effective date of February 1, 2025. We funded the purchase price for the TexMex Acquisition with a combination of cash on hand and borrowings under our Senior Secured Credit Facility.
The TexMex Acquisition includes an average working interest of 42% and an average revenue interest of 35% in approximately 600 wells.
On October 21, 2024, we entered into an ATM equity Sales Agreement (the "ATM Sales Agreement") with Roth Capital

Partners, LLC (the "Lead Agent"), Northland Securities Inc., and A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners pursuant to which we may issue and sell, from time to time, up to $30.0 million of shares of common stock through or to the Lead Agent, acting as agent or principal. For the year ended June 30, 2025, we sold a total of approximately 0.7 million shares of our common stock under the ATM Sales Agreement for net proceeds of approximately $3.5 million, after deducting $0.3 million in offering costs. We intend to use the net proceeds from any sales of common stock for general corporate purposes, including to repay outstanding indebtedness.

Our business strategy is to maximize total shareholder return based on our assessment of the operating environment and marketplace, subject to our obligations to other stakeholders. The key elements of our strategy to accomplish our goal of maximizing shareholder return are:
● Maintaining a strong balance sheet and conservative financial management;

● Growing the asset base through investment in our existing properties, direct acquisitions of new low decline, long-life oil and natural gas properties, selective development opportunities, or accretive acquisitions of similar companies; and
● Returning cash to shareholders by sustaining and growing our dividend payout over time or repurchases of our shares in the open market.

headings: The types of resources we focus on have substantial operational risks.
We have limited control over the activities on properties we do not operate.
We will be subject to risks in connection with acquisitions.
Our inability to complete acquisitions at our historical rate and at appropriate prices that support our long-term strategy could negatively impact our growth rate and stock price.
We may encounter difficulties integrating newly acquired oil and natural gas properties or businesses.
Our oil and natural gas reserves are only estimates and may prove to be inaccurate.
Regulatory and accounting requirements may require substantial reductions in reporting proven reserves.
Our derivative activities could result in financial losses or could reduce our income.
Government regulation and liability for oil and natural gas operations and environmental matters may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
The risks arising out of the threat of climate change, including transition risks and physical risks, may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Poor general economic, business, or industry conditions may have a material adverse effect on our results of operations, liquidity, financial condition and access to capital.

Events outside of our control, including a pandemic or broad outbreak of an infectious disease, such as the global outbreak of a novel strain of the coronavirus ("COVID-19"), may materially adversely affect our business.
Our insurance may not protect us against all of the operating risks to which our business is exposed.
The loss of key personnel could adversely affect us.
Oilfield service and materials prices may increase, and the availability of such services and materials may be inadequate to meet our needs.
We cannot market the oil and natural gas that we produce without the assistance of third-parties.
We face strong competition from larger oil and natural gas companies.
We have been, and in the future may become, involved in legal proceedings related to our properties or operations and, as a result, may incur substantial costs in connection with those proceedings.
Ownership of our oil and natural gas production and mineral rights depends on good title to our property.

Unanticipated changes in effective tax rates or laws or adverse outcomes resulting from examination of our income or other tax returns could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
Risks Associated with our Common Stock
Our stock price has been and may continue to be volatile.
The market for our common stock is limited and may not provide adequate liquidity.
If securities or industry analysts do not publish research reports about our business, or if they downgrade our stock, the price of our common stock could decline.
There may be future sales or issuances of our common stock, which will dilute the ownership interests of stockholders and may adversely affect the market price of our common stock.
Non-U.S. holders may be subject to U.S. income tax and withholding tax with respect to gain on disposition of the Company's common stock.
Investor sentiment towards climate change, fossil fuels, sustainability, and other ESG matters could adversely affect our business and our stock price.
paragraphs: Our business involves a high degree of risk. Our ownership interest in oil and natural gas properties consists of non-operated working, revenue, and/or royalty interests. We do not operate any of our oil and natural gas properties nor do we do have any employees or contractors in the field. Our risks associated with oil and natural gas operations affect us indirectly through our ownership in non-operated working interests where we proportionately share in the costs and liabilities of operating such properties.

If any of the following risks, or any risk described elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, actually occurs, our business, financial condition, or results of operations could suffer. The risks described below are not the only ones facing us. Additional risks not presently known to us or which we currently consider to be immaterial also may adversely affect us.

A substantial or extended decline in oil, natural gas and NGL prices may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and our ability to meet our capital expenditure obligations and financial commitments.

The price we receive for our oil, natural gas and NGLs significantly influences our revenue, profitability, access to capital, capital spending, and future rate of growth. At June 30, 2025, approximately 45% of our proved reserves were oil reserves, 38% were natural gas and 17% were NGLs. Oil, natural gas and NGLs are commodities and their prices are subject to wide fluctuations in response to relatively minor changes in supply and demand. Historically, the markets for oil, natural gas, and NGLs have been volatile and these markets will likely continue to be volatile in the future. The prices we receive for our production depend on numerous factors beyond our control, including, but not limited to the following:
●changes in global supply and demand for oil and natural gas;
●worldwide and regional economic conditions impacting the global supply and demand for oil and natural gas;

paragraphs: Evolution Petroleum Corporation is an independent energy company focused on maximizing total returns to its shareholders through the ownership of and investment in onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States. In support of that objective, our long-term goal is to maximize total shareholder return from a diversified portfolio of long-life oil and natural gas properties built through acquisitions and through selective development opportunities, production enhancements, and other exploitation efforts on our oil and natural gas properties.
Our oil and natural gas properties consist primarily of non-operated interests in the following areas (as well as small overriding royalty interests in four onshore central Texas wells):

● Our non-operated interest in TexMex consists of oil and natural gas producing properties where we hold an approximate 42% net working interest and 35% average net revenue interest located on approximately 27,800 gross (11,200 net) acres (all held by production) primarily in Lea, Eddy and Chaves Counties, New Mexico and Stephens County, Texas. The oil and natural gas properties are operated by Texian Operating Company.

● Our non-operated interests in the SCOOP and STACK plays, consist of oil and natural gas producing properties in the Anadarko basin, where we hold approximately 2.6% average net working interest and approximately 2.0% average net revenue interests located on approximately 103,700 gross (4,200 net) acres (approximately 97% held by production) across Blaine, Canadian, Carter, Custer, Dewey, Garvin, Grady, Kingfisher, McClain, Murray, and Stephens counties in Oklahoma. The oil and natural gas properties are operated by Continental Resources, Inc., Ovintiv USA Inc. and EOG Resources, Inc. with approximately 40% of wells operated by other operators.

● Our non-operated interests in the Chaveroo Field consist of a 50% net working interest, with an average associated 41% revenue interest, in approximately 4,500 gross (2,300 net) acres all held by production, associated with six development blocks, with the right to acquire the same working interest in additional development locations and associated acreage at a fixed price. The field is operated by PEDEVCO Corp. ("PEDEVCO").

● Our non-operated interests in the Jonah Field, a natural gas and NGL property in Sublette County, Wyoming, consist of approximately 20% average net working interest and approximately 15% average net revenue interest located on approximately 5,300 gross (950 net) acres all held by production. The properties are operated by Jonah Energy.

● Our non-operated interests in the Williston Basin, an oil and natural gas producing property, consist of approximately 39% average net working interest and approximately 33% average net revenue interest located on approximately 138,200 gross (41,300 net) acres (approximately 97% held by production) across Billings, Golden Valley, and McKenzie Counties in North Dakota. The properties are operated by Foundation Energy Management.

● Our non-operated interests in the Barnett Shale, a natural gas and NGL producing shale reservoir, consist of approximately 17% average net working interest and approximately 14% average net revenue interest (inclusive of small overriding royalty interests). The approximately 123,800 gross (21,000 net) acres are held by
production across nine North Texas counties. The oil and natural gas properties are primarily operated by Diversified Energy Company with approximately 10% of wells operated by six other operators.

● Our non-operated interests in the Hamilton Dome Field, a secondary recovery field utilizing water injection wells to pressurize the reservoir, consist of approximately 24% average net working interest, with an associated 20% average net revenue interest (inclusive of a small overriding royalty interest). The 5,900 gross acre unitized field, of which we hold approximately 1,400 net acres, is operated by Merit Energy Company, who owns the majority of the remaining working interest in the Hamilton Dome Field. The Hamilton Dome Field is located in the southwest region of the Big Horn Basin in northwest Wyoming.

● Our non-operated interests in the Delhi Field, a CO2-EOR project, consist of approximately 24% average net working interest, with an associated 19% revenue interest and separate overriding royalty and mineral interests of approximately 7% yielding a total average net revenue interest of approximately 26%. The field is operated by Denbury Onshore LLC, a subsidiary of Exxon Mobil Corporation. The 13,600 gross acre unitized Delhi Field, of which we hold approximately 3,200 acres, is located in northeast Louisiana in Franklin, Madison, and Richland Parishes.

paragraphs: Evolution Petroleum Corporation ("Evolution," and together with its consolidated subsidiaries, the "Company", "our", "we, "us" or similar terms) 是一家獨立能源公司，專注於透過擁有及投資美國境內的陸上石油與天然氣資源，以最大化對股東的總回報。我們的長期目標是透過收購與選擇性開發機會、生產提升及其他開發努力，建立一個多元化的長壽命石油與天然氣資源組合，以實現對股東的總回報最大化。
於 2025 年 9 月 11 日，Evolution 的董事會批准並宣佈每季發放 0.12 美元的普通股股息，發放日期為 2025 年 9 月 30 日。

於 2025 年 8 月 4 日，我們完成對 Oklahoma 的 SCOOP/STACK 區域的某些礦物與租權權益的收購（稱為 "Minerals Acquisition"），此收購為現金交易，價值約為 17.0 百萬美元，並受常規的交割後調整條款約束。此 Minerals Acquisition 的生效日期為 2025 年 5 月 1 日。我們以 15.0 百萬美元的貸款及現金結餘共同資助此 Minerals Acquisition 的購價。收購的資產包括平均 0.6% 的租權權益，位於 Oklahoma 的 Grady 及 Canadian 縣約 5,500 平方英呎的淨租權英畝。

於 2025 年 6 月 30 日，我們與 MidFirst Bank 籤訂一份 syndicated amended and restated senior secured reserve-based credit agreement（"Senior Secured Credit Facility"），作為貸款人之一的行政代理，貸款金額最高為 200.0 百萬美元，初始借款基數為 65.0 百萬美元，貸款到期日為 2028 年 6 月 30 日。
有關本公司高階抵押信貸融資之進一步說明，請參閱第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」中之「流動性與資金來源」。

本公司於 2025 年 4 月 14 日完成收購位於美國新墨西哥州 Lea、Eddy 與 Chaves 縣以及德州 Stephens 縣之部分非營運性長期油氣井之工作權益（稱為「TexMex 收購」），該交易係向私人賣方購得。TexMex 收購之總購價約為 9.0 百萬美元，扣除常規之交割後調整後，生效日期為 2025 年 2 月 1 日。本公司以現金及高階抵押信貸融資之借款組合資資金用以支付 TexMex 收購之購價。

paragraphs: Evolution Petroleum Corporation 為一間獨立能源公司，專注於透過擁有及投資美國境內的陸上石油與天然氣資源，以最大化對股東的總回報。為達成此目標，我們的長期目標是透過收購及選擇性開發機會、生產提升及其他開發努力，建立一個多元化的長壽命石油與天然氣資源組合，以實現總股東回報。
我們的石油與天然氣資源主要為非經營權利益，位於以下地區（以及四口位於美國中部德克薩斯州的陸上井的小過 royalty 利益）：
● 我們在 TexMex 的非經營權利益為石油與天然氣生產資源，我們持有約 42% 的淨經營權利益與 35% 的平均淨收入利益，位於約 27,800 總計（11,200 網路）英畝（全部由生產持有），主要位於新墨西哥州的 Lea、Eddy 與 Chaves 縣以及德克薩斯州的 Stephens 縣。該石油與天然氣資源由 Texian Operating Company 管理。

● 我們在 SCOOP 與 STACK 開發區的非經營權利益為石油與天然氣生產資源，位於 Anadarko 基底，我們持有約 2.6% 的平均淨經營權利益與約 2.0% 的平均淨收入利益，位於約 103,700 總計（4,200 網路）英畝（約 97% 由生產持有）橫跨奧克拉荷馬州的 Blaine、Canadian、Carter、Custer、Dewey、Garvin、Grady、Kingfisher、McClain、Murray 與 Stephens 縣。該石油與天然氣資源由 Continental Resources, Inc.、Ovintiv USA Inc. 與 EOG Resources, Inc. 管理，約 40% 的井由其他經營者管理。
● 我們在 Chaveroo 開發區的非經營權利益為 50% 的淨經營權利益，平均相關 41% 收入利益，位於約 4,500 總計（2,300 網路）英畝，全部由生產持有，與六個開發區塊相關，有權以固定價格取得相同經營權利益於其他開發地點與相關英畝數。該開發區由 PEDEVCO Corp.（"PEDEVCO"）管理。
● 我們在 Jonah 開發區的非經營權利益為天然氣與 NGL 資源，位於懷俄明州的 Sublette 縣，我們持有約 20% 的平均淨經營權利益與約 15% 的平均淨收入利益，位於約 5,300 總計（950 網路）英畝，全部由生產持有。該資源由 Jonah Energy 管理。
● 我們在 Williston 基底的非經營權利益為石油與天然氣生產資源，我們持有約 39% 的平均淨經營權利益與約 33% 的平均淨收入利益，位於約 138,200 總計（41,300 網路）英畝（約 97% 由生產持有）橫跨北達科他州的 Billings、Golden Valley 與 McKenzie 縣。該資源由 Foundation Energy Management 管理。
● 我們在 Barnett 基底的非經營權利益為天然氣與 NGL 生產頁巖儲層，我們持有約 17% 的平均淨經營權利益與約 14% 的平均淨收入利益（包含小過 royalty 利益）。約 123,800 總計（21,000 網路）英畝由
生產活動遍及德州北部九個縣。油氣田主要由 Diversified Energy Company 管理，約有 10% 的油井由其他六家運營商管理。

● 我們在 Hamilton Dome Field 的非運營權益，為一處採用水注入井壓實油藏的二次採油場，平均淨工作權益約為 24%，並伴隨平均淨收入權益約為 20%（包含一小部分優先 royalty 權益）。該 5,900 英畝的單位化油田，我們持有約 1,400 英畝的淨權益，由 Merit Energy Company 管理，該公司擁有 Hamilton Dome Field 剩餘大部分工作權益。Hamilton Dome Field 位於懷俄明州西北部的 Big Horn Basin 南西部地區。

● 我們在 Delhi Field 的非運營權益，為一處 CO2-EOR 專案，平均淨工作權益約為 24%，並伴隨 19% 收入權益，以及約 7% 的優先 royalty 及礦業權益，總計平均淨收入權益約為 26%。該油田由 Exxon Mobil Corporation 的子公司 Denbury Onshore LLC 管理。13,600 英畝的單位化 Delhi Field，我們持有約 3,200 英畝，位於路易斯安那州東北部的 Franklin、Madison 及 Richland 縣。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險：
我們所著重的資源類型具有相當程度的運營風險。
我們對不直接經營的不動產之活動缺乏控制力。
我們將面臨與併購相關的風險。
我們若無法以歷史速度及合適價格完成併購，可能不利於我們的成長速度與股票價格。
我們可能在整合新併購的石油與天然氣資產或業務時遇到困難。
我們的石油與天然氣儲備僅為估計值，可能與實際情況有所出入。
法規與會計要求可能導致需大幅減少報告已證實儲備的數量。
本公司之衍生性活動可能導致財務損失，或可能降低本公司之營業收入。
政府規範及油氣開採與環境事項之責任，可能對本公司業務及營運結果產生不利影響。
因氣候變遷之威脅所衍生之風險，包括過渡風險及實體風險，可能對本公司業務及營運結果產生不利影響。
整體經濟、商業或產業條件不佳，可能對本公司營運結果、流動性、財務狀況及取得資金能力產生重大不利影響。
本公司無法控制之事件，包括疫情或廣泛傳播之傳染病，例如新型冠狀病毒（"COVID-19"）之全球爆發，可能對本公司業務產生重大不利影響。
本公司之保險可能無法完全保護本公司免於業務所面臨之所有營運風險。
關鍵人員之流失可能對本公司產生不利影響。
油田服務及物料之價格可能上漲，且相關服務及物料之供應可能不足以滿足本公司之需求。
我們無法在第三方協助下行銷我們所生產的石油與天然氣。
我們面臨來自較大石油與天然氣公司的強烈競爭。
我們已參與，且未來可能參與與我們財產或營運相關的法律程序，因此可能因這些程序而產生重大成本。
我們所生產的石油與天然氣及礦權的所有權取決於我們財產的良好所有權。
未預見的有效稅率或稅法變動，或因審查我們所得或其他稅務申報而產生的不利結果，可能會對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。
與我們普通股相關的風險
我們的股票價格已並可能持續波動。
我們普通股的市場流動性有限，可能無法提供足夠的流動性。
若證券或產業分析師未發表關於本公司業務的研究報告，或若其將本公司股票降級，則本公司普通股價格可能下跌。
未來可能有本公司普通股的銷售或發行，此舉將稀釋股東的持股權益，並可能對本公司普通股的市場價格產生負面影響。
非美國持有人可能就本公司普通股處分所產生的獲利，而成為美國所得稅及扣繳稅的納稅義務人。
投資人對氣候變遷、化石燃料、永續性及其他ESG事項的觀感，可能對本公司業務及股票價格產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及高度風險。本公司在石油與天然氣產權的權益為非經營性工作權益、收入權益及/或 royalty 權益。本公司並未經營任何石油與天然氣產權，亦未在現場有任何員工或承包商。與石油與天然氣作業相關的風險，會透過本公司在非經營性工作權益中的權益間接影響本公司，本公司會按比例分擔相關成本與負債。
若下列任一風險，或本年度報告表 10-K 中其他地方所描述的任何風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成不利影響。下列所描述的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險，目前尚未為本公司所知悉，或本公司目前認為不重要，亦可能對本公司造成不利影響。
石油、天然氣與 NGL 價格出現顯著或持續下跌，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果及履行資本支出義務與財務承諾的能力造成不利影響。

本公司所收到的石油、天然氣與 NGL 價格，會顯著影響本公司營業收入、獲利能力、取得資金的能力、資本支出及未來成長率。截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日，本公司已證實儲量中約 45% 為石油儲量，38% 為天然氣，17% 為 NGL。石油、天然氣與 NGL 屬於商品，其價格會因供應與需求的微小變化而大幅波動。歷史資料顯示，石油、天然氣與 NGL 的市場表現極為波動，未來這些市場也將持續波動。本公司所收到的生產價格，取決於許多超出本公司控制範圍的因素，包括但不限於以下因素：
●全球石油與天然氣供需的變化；
●全球及區域經濟狀況對全球石油與天然氣供需的影響；
